issues: The `analyze_text` function is not defined as a module-level function, but rather as an instance method of the main class. — The code should be refactored to define `analyze_text` as a standalone function or a static method.

The `analyze_text` function does not handle empty Unicode text correctly. It will return incorrect results for an empty string. — Add input validation to check if the text is empty before processing it.

The code does not provide a command-line interface that reads a UTF-8 file and emits JSON as specified in the requirements. — Implement the required functionality using the `argparse` library or another suitable method.

The program does not handle invalid filenames correctly. It will throw an exception when trying to open a non-existent file. — Add error handling to catch and handle exceptions that occur when opening files.
